system.description:
Reduce the target's [Fatigue] intensity by -60. The target may select one skill from the skills they currently possess that has the [Magic Attack] tag and increase its SR by 1 (cannot exceed the maximum SR. This effect is treated as a CS). Various potions that raise magic power have been thrown into a big pot and boiled to a bubbling mess. Though the appearance is grotesque, for some reason it is extremely delicious. However, you'd be better off not knowing what the ingredients are.

Snow Peach [Core Material] (440G) + Chicken Box (200G) + Panacea (Intermediate) (220G) + Vial of Magic Spirit (Intermediate) (260G) + [Magic Catalyst 15] (220G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (580G)
